# Robótica

> Educational robotics website: free courses by level, editorial blog notes, and a material hub (GitHub, PDF, video, docs).

- Site: https://educational-robotics-website.vercel.app/
- Repo: https://github.com/andresWeitzel/andresWeitzel.github.io
- Language: Spanish (es-AR)
- License: Open source

## Pages

- Home: https://educational-robotics-website.vercel.app/
- Blog: https://educational-robotics-website.vercel.app/pages/blog.html
- Material / repositories: https://educational-robotics-website.vercel.app/pages/repositorios.html
- Courses hub (home anchor): https://educational-robotics-website.vercel.app/#cursos

## Course hubs

- Introducción a la Robótica: /pages/cursos/introduccion-robotica/index.html
- Electrónica básica: /pages/cursos/electronica-basica/index.html
- Sensores y actuadores: /pages/cursos/sensores-actuadores/index.html
- Arduino: /pages/cursos/arduino/index.html
- Prácticas con Arduino: /pages/cursos/practicas-arduino/index.html
- Robots móviles: /pages/cursos/robots-moviles/index.html
- Visión por computadora: /pages/cursos/vision-por-computadora/index.html
- IoT con Wemos: /pages/cursos/iot-wemos/index.html
- ROS: /pages/cursos/ros/index.html

## Features

- Courses by level (Inicial, Intermedio, Avanzado)
- Internal lessons with theory and practice
- Editorial blog with original notes
- Material hub grouped by course
